name: Bent-over barbell row
description: Hinge forward at the hips, pull the bar to your lower ribs, and lower it with control.
caution: Heavy rowing loads the lower back. Keep a neutral spine and brace before each rep.

name: Lat pulldown
description: Pull the bar to your upper chest while keeping your chest tall and elbows driving down.

name: Seated cable row
description: Sit tall, pull the handle to your waist, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
description: Brace one hand on a bench, pull the dumbbell toward your hip, and keep your torso still.

name: Band pull-apart
description: Hold a band at shoulder height and pull your hands apart, squeezing your upper back.

name: Inverted row
description: Hang under a bar with a straight body and pull your chest up to the bar.

name: Face pull
description: Pull a rope to face height, separating the ends and keeping your elbows high.

name: Superman hold
description: Lie face down, lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor, then hold briefly.

name: Straight-arm pulldown
description: With straight arms, pull a bar down to your thighs using your lats.

name: Renegade row
description: From a plank on dumbbells, row one weight up while keeping your hips square.

name: Standing band row
description: Anchor a band at chest height and row toward your ribs with slow, steady pulls.

name: Prone cobra
description: Lie face down and lift your chest a few centimetres off the floor, holding briefly with a relaxed neck.
